description: Save a local image file into the project's permanent visual memory. Use this to remember UI states, diagrams, architecture graphs, or bug screenshots. The image is copied into Prism's media vault and indexed in the handoff metadata. On the next session_load_context, the agent will see a lightweight index of available images.

description.description: What does this image show? Used for indexing and context display.

file_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the image file (png, jpg, jpeg, webp, gif, svg).

project.description: Project identifier — must match an existing project.

name: session_save_image
